seo.title: Editorial Policy — How We Make Content | Dollar Bets
seo.meta_description: How Dollar Bets picks markets, makes content, uses AI tools, and keeps things honest. Our editorial standards, author info, and corrections policy.

body.content: Dollar Bets is a daily editorial board, not a sportsbook, not a tout sheet, and not an algorithm pretending to be a person. Every page on this site reflects human editorial judgment. Here's how that works.

Dollar Bets is written and edited by James Lamon, founder and editor. Previously EVP Content & Operations at Footballco (GOAL, World Soccer) and Head of Content Europe at BuzzFeed, where he spent seven years building editorial and branded content at scale. He is not a licensed oddsmaker, professional gambler, financial adviser, or prediction-market analyst. He is a content person who finds these markets genuinely fascinating and thinks the $1 framing makes them accessible to everyone.

Every day, Dollar Bets scans thousands of live markets on Kalshi — a US-regulated prediction market exchange — and selects roughly ten that are actually interesting to a normal human being. Selection is based on editorial judgment: Is it funny? Is it culturally relevant? Is the payout absurd enough to make someone lean in? Is there a story behind it? Markets are not selected based on likelihood of winning. Most of the markets we feature are longshots. That's the point.

Dollar Bets uses software and AI tools to help monitor markets, organize research, draft summaries, and format betting-slip cards. Every published page is reviewed, edited, and approved by a human editor. Our market selections and quips reflect editorial judgment, not automated betting advice. We use AI the way a newsroom uses wire services — as inputs to a human editorial process, not as a replacement for it.

content: We do not give betting advice. We curate markets for entertainment.
We do not claim any bet is likely to win. Longshots are longshots for a reason.
We do not fabricate odds, search data, or market statistics.
We do not use language like 'guaranteed,' 'lock,' 'risk-free,' or 'can't lose.'
We do not pretend to have expertise we do not have.
We do not publish content designed to manipulate search rankings without providing genuine value to readers.

body.content: Dollar Bets contains affiliate links to Kalshi. If you click through and trade, we may earn a commission. This does not affect which markets we feature or how we describe them. Our full affiliate disclosure is here.

Markets move. Facts change. If something on this site is wrong, outdated, or misleading, we want to fix it. Email james.lamon@gmail.com and we'll correct it. Content pages display a last-updated date so you know when they were last reviewed.

Betting involves real money and real risk. Dollar Bets encourages small-stake, entertainment-focused participation. Never bet more than you can afford to lose. If gambling is causing problems in your life, visit our responsible gambling resources page.

compliance: Dollar Bets is an editorial and entertainment site. All market links are affiliate links to Kalshi. Not financial or betting advice.
